usedFor: Deleting a contact in Intercom removes their files from Dropbox.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Is Deleted” in Intercom, then “Delete File or Folder” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: A deleted contact is the one Intercom event that clearly means their files should go too.

watchOut: “Delete File or Folder” removes everything inside the folder, so target one contact's folder and test first.
